items.text: Cardinals trading WR Marvin Harrison Jr. and a 7th to Texans for 2027 2nd and 6th. Harrison inactive for Cardinals game as deal finalized; reunites with C.J. Stroud.
items.why: Blockbuster reported by Rapoport and Schefter; confirmed by coaches.
items.implication: Fresh start for MHJ with Stroud; immediate WR depth for Texans behind Collins; ARI targets open for Wilson et al.
items.opportunity: Increased competition/targets battle in HOU; volume spike potential for ARI remaining WRs

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out with groin injury (was Q).
items.why: Schefter report; Rapoport had Q earlier.
items.implication: HOU backfield shifts; handcuffs/backups elevated for carries.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for remaining HOU RBs.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty will play after GTD/plantar fasciitis + ankle; confirmed go by Rapoport.
items.why: ETR final update and Rapoport sources; pregame workout cleared.
items.implication: Raiders RB1 role intact; no major handcuff elevation.
items.opportunity: Expected lead carries/routes if healthy enough.

items.text: Justin Jefferson active vs Saints; Jordan Addison and Odell Beckham Jr. inactive.
items.why: Schefter and ETR updates; Jefferson wanted to play in Louisiana.
items.implication: Jefferson full workload; Addison out boosts Jefferson target monopoly short-term.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Jefferson with Addison out.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins will play vs Dolphins after questionable tags.
items.why: ETR final updates and Schefter confirmation both will play.
items.implication: Full CIN WR corps available; no major role expansion for backups.
items.opportunity: Standard high target share expected for both.

items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel out remainder of game (and ruled out) with hamstring.
items.why: Schefter and Rapoport mid/late game reports.
items.implication: SF WR targets to others; monitor severity for ROS.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps for remaining 49ers skill players.

items.text: Zay Flowers officially active for SNF vs Falcons (was expected/Q foot).
items.why: Schefter confirmation of inactives; ETR expected.
items.implication: Ravens WR1 available with Huntley starting.
items.opportunity: Primary target share in pass game.

items.text: Jaylen Warren should be workhorse; coaching staffs refuse despite advanced stats/eye test (Ekeler-esque). Was splitting with Dowdle pre-injury; Dowdle not expected.
items.why: Passes every test; high snaps/routes/carries in absence.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with Dowdle out; clear lead back.
items.opportunity: 97% snaps, high route/carry share previously without Dowdle.

items.text: Ladd McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps (foot); earlier not expected.
items.implication: LAC WR targets redistributed; others like Harris elevated.
items.opportunity: Boosted routes/targets for remaining Chargers WRs.

items.text: Terry McLaurin will play / active after GTD.
items.why: ETR final and Schefter actives list.
items.implication: WAS WR1 available with Daniels returning.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams officially inactive; chance to play next week.
items.why: Rapoport and ETR not expected; Schefter actives confirm.
items.implication: Backup QB start; CHI pass game impacted, run scheme still strong.
items.opportunity: Potential RB usage boost (Swift) in committee.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs best salary-adjusted value in projections; only 61.5% owned in DK single-entry double-ups despite elite projection. Must-play in cash.
items.why: Top value by big margin on DK/FD; DET-ARZ environment.
items.implication: High floor/ceiling RB1; leverage in DFS cash/GPP.
items.opportunity: Elite usage in high-scoring Lions offense.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.implication: Hot waiver add in GB backfield for depth/upside.
items.opportunity: Potential increased role if injuries or committee shift.

items.text: Vikings TE T.J. Hockenson (concussion) downgraded to out.
items.why: Rapoport report; on ETR watch list.
items.implication: MIN TE targets to backups; Jefferson already booming.
